instruments.notes: Purchased put at $17 and sold call at $20 on approx. 3,300 bbl/d of oil production for an eighteen month period beginning March 1, 1995; strikes based on average exchange crude price, monthly settlement; premiums amortized ($0.4 million in 1995); no options exercised in 1995. End month not stated in text.
instruments.evidence_quote:
the Company purchased a put option and sold a call option covering
approximately 3,300 barrels per day of crude oil production for an eighteen
month period beginning March 1, 1995.

instruments.notes: Put option purchased for second half of 1994 for crude oil production; strike and volume not stated; not exercised because market prices were higher than strike. Expired prior to the 1995 year-end.
instruments.evidence_quote:
In  addition,  for  the  second half of 1994, the Company  purchased  a  put
option  for its crude oil production to guarantee the Company a specific minimum
sales  price  for the volume of production hedged.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Limited program hedging crude oil inventories and fixed purchase price commitments using crude oil futures and options; also bought put/sold call options to guarantee minimum sales price on oil production.
